project.description: Build the checked-out Historical Nebula revision on this server. Runs frontend and backend tests, then archives the Vite dist package. This job does not deploy.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -Eeuo pipefail
source_dir=/srv/historical-nebula/source base_workspace=${WORKSPACE:?} if [[ "$base_workspace" != /var/lib/jenkins/workspace/historical-nebula-build ]]; then echo "Unexpected Jenkins workspace: $base_workspace" >&2 exit 1 fi
revision=$(git -c safe.directory="$source_dir" -C "$source_dir" rev-parse HEAD) rm -rf -- "$base_workspace/project" mkdir -p "$base_workspace/project" git -c safe.directory="$source_dir" -C "$source_dir" archive "$revision" | tar -xf - -C "$base_workspace/project"
export BUILD_REVISION="${revision:0:12}" export WORKSPACE="$base_workspace/project" bash "$WORKSPACE/deploy/jenkins-build.sh"
